heroDescription: Create groups, add expenses, and see who owes whom — fast and fair. Perfect for trips, roommates, and group activities.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Up and running in under two minutes.

step1.title: Create a group or go solo
step1.description: Start a group for a trip, shared apartment, or event — or just use Chipin solo to track your own spending.

step2.title: Add expenses as they happen
step2.description: Log any expense in seconds, choose who paid and how it’s split. Chipin does the math for everyone.

step3.title: See balances instantly
step3.description: Chipin shows a clear summary of who owes what. No spreadsheets, no awkward conversations.

step4.title: Settle up with one tap
step4.description: When it’s time to pay back, record the settlement and Chipin marks the debt as cleared.

features.subtitle: Powerful features designed to make splitting expenses effortless — whether you're in a group or flying solo.

smartGroups.title: Smart Groups
smartGroups.description: Create groups for trips, households, or events. Invite members via shareable links and keep everyone in sync with real-time balance updates.

quickExpense.title: Quick Expense Entry
quickExpense.description: Add expenses in seconds. Split equally or by custom amounts. Attach receipts and categorize for better tracking.

autoCalc.title: Auto Calculations
autoCalc.description: See who owes whom instantly. Our smart algorithm minimises the number of transactions needed to settle up.

soloBudget.title: Solo Budget Mode
soloBudget.description: Track personal expenses without a group. Set budgets, monitor spending by category, and stay on top of your finances.

multiCurrency.title: Multi-currency
multiCurrency.description: Travelling abroad? Add expenses in any currency. Chipin handles conversion automatically so everyone pays the right amount.

settleUp.title: Settle Up
settleUp.description: Record settlements in one tap. Chipin marks debts as cleared and keeps a clean history of all payments.

groups.description: Organise trips, households, or events. Share an invite link, and keep everyone’s balances visible in one place. No more chasing people for money.

bullets.shareableLink: Invite via shareable link — no signup required for members
bullets.realTimeBalances: See real-time balances for every person
bullets.debtSimplification: Smart debt simplification reduces the number of payments

expenses.description: You don’t need a group to benefit from Chipin. Use solo mode to track personal expenses, set category budgets, and get a clear picture of where your money goes.

bullets.setBudgets: Set budgets per category and monitor progress
bullets.worksAlongside: Works alongside your group expenses seamlessly

cta.subtitle: Join 50,000+ users who already use Chipin to split bills and track budgets — completely free.
